requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model representing the relevance scoring request including user_condition_intent as a structured field.
The system must include trial_conditions as a structured list field in the Pydantic request schema aligned with clinical_trials_models.py.
The system must define a normalized relevance_score field in the response schema constrained between 0.0 and 1.0.
The system must include a contributing_factors field in the response schema capturing structured explanations for the score.
The system must include a confidence field in the response schema representing scoring certainty between 0.0 and 1.0.
The system must enforce schema validation errors when required fields (user_condition_intent or trial_conditions) are missing.
The system must reject invalid data types for schema fields (e.g., non-list trial_conditions) via Pydantic validation.
The system must align field naming and structure with existing clinical_trials_models.py conventions.
The system must support serialization of the schema to JSON for downstream service consumption.
The system must ensure the schema supports multiple trial conditions without failure.
The system must allow empty contributing_factors while still producing a valid schema response.
The system must handle the case where trial_conditions is an empty list by producing a valid response with relevance_score = 0.0.
The system must ensure compatibility of the schema with downstream scoring logic defined in EVAL-CT-REL-002.
The system must define contributing_factors as structured objects (not free text) to support deterministic parsing.
The system must constrain confidence to numeric values between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.
The system must ensure the schema supports LLM-generated inputs without requiring post-processing transformations.
The system must enforce deterministic field presence so LLM outputs always include relevance_score, contributing_factors, and confidence.
The system must ensure contributing_factors entries include a factor_type and factor_score field.
The system must support partial or fuzzy condition representations in user_condition_intent without schema failure.
The system must validate that relevance_score is present even when no contributing factors are identified.
